name: @code-moniker/client
description: Typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for the Code Moniker workspace daemon.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:types && npm run generate:protocol
scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/client.test.mjs test/node.test.mjs test/diff-impact.test.mjs
scripts.test:consumer: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p test/consumer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/consumer/tsconfig.nodenext.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/consumer/tsconfig.node-types-free.json
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node --test test/package.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-packages.mjs && node scripts/verify-pack.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:consumer && npm run test:package
